title: China Hami Nuclear Silo Field — Continued Monitoring (Reuters Satellite Imagery Update)
snippet: Continued satellite monitoring of China's Hami ICBM silo field in Xinjiang desert. 80+ concrete launch pads, octagonal installations, and armored bunkers. WorldView-3 and PlanetScope imagery confirmed by 3 independent security analysts. Scale described as unprecedented.
tag_reason: evt-3501 China Hami tracked since 2026-06-15. Continuing monitoring of unprecedented nuclear infrastructure buildup.
